cordWidth.$description: Pull cord: width of its stage (room to sway).

cordLength.$description: Pull cord: resting length from the ceiling plate to the bead.

cordMaxPull.$description: Pull cord: furthest the bead can be pulled.

cordThreshold.$description: Pull cord: fraction of the full pull that switches the mode.

cordWidthStroke.$description: Pull cord: thickness of the cord.

bead.$description: Pull cord: diameter of the pull bead.

springStiffness.$description: Pull cord: spring stiffness (per frame) pulling the bead back to rest.

springDamping.$description: Pull cord: velocity kept each frame (lower settles sooner).

springKick.$description: Pull cord: initial tug when pulled by keyboard or a tap.

sunMoonIcon.$description: Sun and moon switch: icon size inside the thumb.

dialAngle.$description: Mode dial: rotation of the Light and Dark detents either side of Auto.

dialLabelRadius.$description: Mode dial: distance of the labels from the centre.

corona.$description: Eclipse button: glow around the eclipsed sun.

skyNight.$description: Eclipse button and sun and moon switch: the moon and night sky (illustration palette, fixed in both modes).

sun.$description: Eclipse button and sun and moon switch: the sun.

settle.$description: Sun and moon switch and eclipse: time to settle into a new mode.

moonPartial.$description: Eclipse button: how far the moon covers the sun for Auto.

moonTotal.$description: Eclipse button: the moon almost covers the sun for Dark, leaving a sliver.

chainBall.$description: Pull cord: diameter of each ball in the ball chain.

chainSpacing.$description: Pull cord: distance between ball centres along the chain.

metalLight.$description: Pull cord: highlight on the metal balls (fixed in both modes, like real nickel).

metalMid.$description: Pull cord: body of the metal balls.

metalDark.$description: Pull cord: shaded edge of the metal balls and the wire.

metalInk.$description: Pull cord: icon engraved on the metal pull.
